title: Finite Imaginary-Time Evolution for Polynomial Unconstrained Binary Optimization
summary: Imaginary-time evolution is a standard primitive for ground-state preparation but is nonunitary, precluding direct quantum implementation. We develop Finite Imaginary-Time Evolution (FinITE), a finite-beta construction for diagonal Pauli-Z cost Hamiltonians arising from polynomial unconstrained binary optimization (PUBO) instances, including QUBO and HUBO cases. FinITE uses the linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) framework to implement a scaled imaginary-time propagator.
